Set K=K6=1124583/250000. For delta in[0.68,0.70], rho=1-10delta/[3(5-2delta)], k=rho+delta-1, D_K=15K-10-6Kdelta, a_K=delta(5-6delta)^2/[3(5-2delta)D_K], b_K=2delta(5-6delta)(K-1)/D_K, and G_K(W,z)=min(3kz,a_K W+b_K z).
Retain the original canonical witness lines P_K(m)=1-2delta m+delta[v-(1-2m)/K]_+, I(r)=1-delta r+delta[v-(1-r)/2]_+ for r<=1, and L(r)=1/6+(5/6-delta)r+delta v for r>=1. The same zero/presentation, r+m>=t in[1,3/2], m<=1/2 and v=z/W remain. Balancing fully marked and partially marked branches gives the displayed minimum, while old unmarked fallbacks pay tolerated small endpoint errors. This witness optimization is algebra, not a complete transformed weighted-source theorem.
At delta=0.68, aq=89930000/66751546407, bq=683923906/6112778975, B=19131626842271833/19342954694500000, Lambda=155270174886/38685909389. Keep 600 original cells of width 1/100000 on[0.034,0.04]. At upper/lower endpoints u_j,l_j, freeze g_j=B-1+(9/2-Lambda)u_j, amp_j=(34/21)g_j+1/400000, A_j=B-(Lambda-1)l_j. The amplifier belongs to its original cell and is not reset after shortening. The retained correlated-cell scalar menu passes: low reserve 7/30000000 and new-high reserve 7505714949231936682453/3310697789585680147850000000>0. The retained derivative test covers the full delta interval; extracted-error, second-zero, first-inverse, support and V-22z margins remain.
The complete valuation price E1<=-Hval(delta)c_s-E uses Hval=min(delta+1-4rho,delta-(6+27rho)/37), retains both residues, removes positive multiplicities by six and does not assume squarefree plain variables. G_K is concave in z and zero at z=0, so its chord gives the retained-width lower bound. With W>=M-6a-c_s, changing W costs at most aq c_s and preserves the full -6a amplification cost, only if the actual live-list G_K source estimate is supplied.
Keep c11=312864909/2500000000, h=0.795383, t0=0.00104, Nplain=0.4222, zsafe=0.03724. The recomputed 22/6/1 closed covers have 348 positive Bernstein coefficients; new-row minimum 45813542734199051634582673952441/87884571424077595735045963776000000000000 is positive for the certificate with requested saving 1e-10. The source reports 40 scalar gates passing, including weighted Euler shifts, principal/tail costs and feedback from the actual supremum. The independent reviewer reconstructs the binding K6/c11 cell by rational interpolation; it does not duplicate the entire inherited coefficient computation.
The old original-source cone fails at n1=n2=627189454/1491343125 and z=7423176895563297123089/201352804925647419000000, with excess509341971983370185661949/481937938589537097376500000>0. This fixed domain defect survives arbitrary mesh refinement. Numerical sufficiency does not establish changed-source admission.
The missing theorem may be restricted to M=1, fixed admissible WeightedSourceData F, real slot power 33/50, original live windows, the K6 cone and the changed original-cell amplifier. It must pay the complete weighted high ordinary main family after both signed transforms with G_K on every actual canonical live product; all supported allocation/fiber, original full-zero filter, complete second projector, dictionary/anchor bridge, natural puncture, orientation and independent heights remain. It must pay the complete normalized error family with original radical-capped witness and retained contraction:56/#P occurs once; for L2=3(Nslot+2), the intended normalized exponent is(7+3L2)delta-7/60000000, followed by one ratio conversion adding delta and final target<=-7/120000000. The old schedule supplies that target only after changed admission and source caps are proved. All first/second/artificial-zero, bounded-window and fixed-inducing pieces retain original masks and complete centered rectangles.
If geometry or gap changes, construct fresh admissible slots and F: meshes before finite N, then e after the positive minimum width, and re-establish FirstTail(4e). Reusing a generic theorem does not validate an old chosen-data instance for a new gap; the common decrement is fixed before the later target zero. Thus K6 is numerically sufficient for the existing conditional source-relative c11 return, not a proved endpoint or a higher constant.
